title: Ivy-ngcc: Fail to compile in rc.02

milestone.title: Backlog

body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Is this a regression? NO ### Description When I'm trying to enable the Ivy compiler options, in the `postinstall `script, I receive an error: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10500082/57306333-ed707200-70e2-11e9-80b8-70cae06bd219.png) I think it's related by [`ngx-markdown`](https://github.com/jfcere/ngx-markdown) library, but I cannot recognize the error. [Here](https://unpkg.com/ngx-markdown@7.1.5/fesm5/ngx-markdown.js) is the file I think it fails. I've taken a look to this issue [#29835](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/29835) but all seems to be ok. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction ``` ng new repro-app --skip-install cd repro-app ``` Replace package.json with this [file](https://github.com/Aw3same/repro-err/blob/master/package.json) `npm i ` ## 🔥 Exception or Error
